test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Shakti starts from Point A and drives 22 km towards South. He then takes a left turn, drives 20 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 17 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 10 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
Given:

Shakti starts from Point A and drives 22 km towards South.

He then takes a left turn, drives 20 km, turns left and drives 12 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 17 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 10 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8161419eb73b8fb2f16e42dcd0905dc3ef90f35993b8139a0435104a4b83a010.png] 

Thus, Shakti should drive (20 km - 17 km) 3 km in the west direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
